Variks is grateful for your work on Europa. He hopes you will continue to help him as new threats arise every day.

He offers you a token of his gratitude.
Variks takes the offered gift carefully in one of his lower hands. "It is good to be your friend," he says gratefully.

Variks is alarmed to hear about Eramis's lieutenants using Stasis. The situation is more dire than he realized.

He wants to remain on Europa in order to help other Eliksni who wish to flee Eramis, and asks you to help set up a comms network using a nearby array. That way, he can communicate with his allies and prepare for evacuation.

Help Variks set up the patrols network in Charon's Crossing.

Variks disapproves of your new Stasis abilities. He thinks you're being reckless. He warns you to remember what the Darkness has done and what it is doing to Eramis. He refuses to believe that this is the only way to stop her.

But he acknowledges that you are free to walk your own path, even if it's a dangerous one. He urges you not to lose sight of your goal. To get to Eramis, you must begin by defeating the leader of her army: Phylaks. Thanks to his secret communication network, Variks learned that Phylaks was ordered to take control of an area currently occupied by the Vex.

Gather information about the whereabouts of Phylaks, the Warrior by challenging her soldiers in Eventide Ruins.

Variks is surprised and impressed that you managed to defeat Phylaks. He now believes you may be capable of wielding Stasis without being corrupted.

He tells you that your next target is Praksis, the Eliksni who created the technology that allows House Salvation to wield Darkness. Defeat him and Eramis's plans will come to a halt. Variks believes he's been experimenting on the Vex, and if you disrupt his experiments, you might get his attention.

Investigate Praksis, the Technocrat's plans in Asterion Abyss.

Variks looks somber. When he witnessed Eramis releasing the Vex, he realized that she has truly lost sight of what she was fighting for. Now she has endangered everything the Eliksni have built on Europa.

As the Vex make their way across Europa and towards Riis-Reborn, Variks is planning to help some of his allies evacuate the city. They are carrying an important asset that he claims will be invaluable to House Light on Earth. He asks for your help defending them, and then the way will be clear for you to confront Eramis.

Help Variks evacuate the allied Fallen in Eventide Ruins.

Variks tells you about Eramis, a new Kell of the Fallen, or the Eliksni, as they call themselves. Through communing with Pyramids, she has managed to harness the power of Darkness and use it as a weapon.

Variks escaped with proof of that Dark power, asking for help. If Eramis succeeds in giving this power to all of her Eliksni followers, nothing, not even the Guardians, will be able to defeat her.

Variks asks you to find Eramis immediately. Perhaps she can still be stopped.

Pursue Eramis, Kell of Darkness. Complete "The New Kell" mission.

Variks examines the materials you've brought him. "Remnants of your Golden Age," he muses. "Samples found and preserved. Or, perhaps, Clovis Bray wished to bring more Earth-life to Europa. I cannot say for certain." 

Either way, he believes this may be a valuable resource and would like to help you find more.

You can now find more planetary materials in the Europa Eclipsed Zone.

"Kridis seeks to claim power," Variks says. "She has always had ambition to prove herself Kell-worthy."

He leans closer to you. "Variks hears whispers that her followers are collecting remnants of the Dark. To stop her, we must understand why."
"This armor was built long ago for the harsh conditions of Europa. Take it. Use it wisely."
You can now obtain Herealways Pieces by completing patrols, Lost Sectors, and public events on Europa. Herealways Pieces can be used to purchase various quests from Variks.

"Your commander has asked me to lead you once more through Riis-Reborn," Variks says. "Another attack on the city, to see how the Vex have fared. Eliksni of House Salvation will not expect us. They are distracted by their fight."

He shakes his head. "Their loss, your gain."

Help the Vanguard investigate the Vex presence in the Fallen city by completing the mission "The Aftermath."

Variks is somber when you approach. Eramis's single-minded quest for revenge made her unfit to lead the Eliksni, but Variks mourns her all the same.

But there is little time to mourn. Variks knows new Eliksni challengers will rise on Europa. He agrees to help you and the Vanguard take down what remains of House Salvation.

Complete the "Sabotaging Salvation" mission.
"This armor was built long ago for the harsh conditions of Europa. Take it. Use it wisely."

"As you saw when you attacked the factory, Vex swarm Riis-Reborn," Variks says bitterly. "They are pests. But your commander is right. Such pests will make House Salvation weak."

"Variks will help you and your Vanguard once more. House Salvation must be destroyed, yes?"

Variks offers to guide you through several low-level sabotage operations, so that you might take advantage of House Salvation's disorganized state.

Complete two Sabotage quests acquired from Variks.

"Kridis wishes to triumph where Eramis failed," Variks says gravely. "She has plans within Riis-Reborn. To revive House Salvation."

He watches you steadily. "My spies say she gathers Darkness around her. Hoards it. Planning something." He shakes his head. "Variks knows not. You must uncover her plans. We cannot fail now. Too much has been lost."

Learn more about the plans of Kridis, the Dark Priestess by seeking out her followers in Cadmus Ridge.

"Old secrets emerge in the wake of your kind invading the Deep Stone Crypt. Something siphons power where it didn't before, in Bray Exoscience."

"Investigate, yes?"

"You found and dealt with all of House Salvation's intrusive drones, yes? Another strike to what remains of Eramis's empire. Variks is most pleased. And now, I extend that pleasure to you, in the form of this token of power. May it serve you well, savior."
